name: On / Off Switch
description: A switch that can be turned on or off, with configurable behaviors. It can interact with Four-Person Switch (SWT4) and Logical Switch (LOSW) actors.

fields.name: Timer
fields.description: Initial countdown value used by the switch's delayed behavior.

fields.name: Switch Behavior
fields.description: Selects the switch's behavior, including state changes, timing.

1.name: On / Off
1.description: The switch can be turned on or off.

2.name: Time
2.description: The switch remains active for the configured duration.

3.name: Persistent On / Off
3.description: The switch state follows the configured global flag and persists when leaving the room.

4.name: Persistent On / Off (Alternate)
4.description: The switch state follows the configured global flag and persists when leaving the room, using alternate state handling.

fields.name: Initial Activation Condition
fields.description: Determines the switch's initial activation state based on the number of active players.

1.name: 2 Players
1.description: The switch starts activated when exactly 2 players are active.

2.name: 2 or 3 Players
2.description: The switch starts activated when 2 or 3 players are active.

fields.name: Triggered Variable
fields.description: The global flag number used to determine the switch state. The flag can be checked, set, or cleared.
